problems.title: Linear limit state, d = 2
problems.description: G = 3 - (u1 + u2)/sqrt 2 in standard normal space.

problems.title: Linear limit state, d = 10
problems.description: G = 3.5 - sum(u)/sqrt 10 in standard normal space.

problems.title: Parabolic limit state
problems.reference_note: 1-D quadrature E[Phi(-(3 + 0.25 Z^2))], Simpson, 4000 panels on [-12, 12]; identical to 16 digits with 8000 panels.

problems.title: Four-branch series system
problems.description: min of four branches (Echard et al. 2011, k = 6); two design points on each axis pair.
problems.reference_note: 1-D quadrature in rotated coordinates (Simpson, 4000 panels); confirmed by a seeded crude Monte Carlo run of 10^7 samples: 4.43780e-03 +/- 2.10e-05 (z = -0.93).

problems.title: Ishigami Sobol and Shapley indices
problems.description: Ishigami function (a = 7, b = 0.1) on U(-pi, pi)^3.
problems.reference_note: Analytic variance decomposition (V1, V2, V13); Shapley effects split V13 equally between x1 and x3.

problems.title: Linear model, correlated Gaussian inputs
problems.reference_note: Closed-form Shapley effects s_J' Sigma_JJ^-1 s_J (independent implementation; equals probstat's linear_gaussian_shapley).

problems.title: Ishigami mean and variance
problems.description: Mean and variance of the Ishigami output on U(-pi, pi)^3.
problems.reference_note: Analytic: mean a/2, variance a^2/8 + b pi^4/5 + b^2 pi^8/18 + 1/2.

problems.title: Linear-Gaussian calibration
problems.description: y = a + b t + eps, 8 points on t in [0, 2], sigma = 0.5 known, prior N(0, I); true (a, b) drawn from the prior per seed.
